_comment: Options to add to each select field after creation. Apply via POST /rest/api/3/field/{fieldId}/context/{contextId}/option · Body: { "options": [ { "value": "..." } ] }. The first 4 fields are NEW (created by custom_fields.json). The last 4 are REUSE — only add options if Avangrid's existing global options don't already match. Skip if already populated.

reuse_fields_options_required._comment: Verify these options exist on the listed REUSE fields before associating to DGTLPROD screens. If missing, add via the same endpoint. Field IDs are from the Avangrid global registry (see ADMIN_HANDOFF.md §4a).
